title: CORA maturity assurance: abstract goal to backward-derived AND reticulum
abstract_goal: An independent user and AI can discover and use CORA's declared capabilities, trace every bounded source claim to original evidence, understand unknowns, and obtain governed reliable decisions over time.
epistemic_invariants: Git path existence is not runtime execution.
A source witness and its derived report share one origin and are not independent confirmations.
HTML readability is not user acceptance.
A test-source reference is not a passed test.
Synthetic-model counts cannot substitute real behavior.
Independent host protections, human approval, external pilot, release publication and longitudinal operation are not Git-source evidence.
No local model, agent response or report grants authorization.

nodes.description: Committed product identity, not distributed-product acceptance.
Named software and Python entrypoint are internally consistent.
Git identity, source provenance and repository roots are explicit.
Alpha release status and packaging declaration are bounded.
Published independently approved and user-accepted distribution; no source-only promotion.
Distinct identity source contracts.
Product/software/repository/release boundary includes independent release.
Pin exact Git revision for observations.
Recompute original evidence from Git, not from report self-hashes.
Changed dependencies invalidate witnesses; unaffected still require revalidation.
Shared Git origins are counted once; correlation not independent corroboration.
Scoped original-source verification only.
Named source tests and synthetic falsifiers, not behavioral population statistics.
Independent maintained real-repository benchmark with precision/recall and non-regression.
Independent test labeling, runtime behavior and external reproducibility.
No real behavioral assurance from synthetic source models.
Workflow and policy structure observed as source.
Host-enforced required checks and protected branch inspected independently.
Authenticated non-author human reviewer and separation of duties.
Green CI cannot self-authenticate governance.
Catalog binds all declared CLI commands, methods, sources and tests.
Deterministic accessible self-contained navigable HTML and machine report.
Observed unaided newcomer completion and correct interpretation of scope.
Readable HTML is not independently measured usability.
Source-scoped regressions and exact-head gate.
Source-bound pre/postmerge analysis exists.
Real maintained-target longitudinal drift and incident observation.
Independent verified restore and operational rollback.
No long-term release fitness inferred from fast PR sequence.
All six gates required; no compensating scores or self-approval.
